    • initialize

      public boolean initialize(UIListener parent, int groupID, float baseDepth, String typefaceFilePath, float textPadding, float textSize)
      Initialize this user-interface group's memory
      Parameters:
      parent - The parent user-interface listener for this group
      groupID - The ID for this group
      baseDepth - The smallest depth to draw user-interface components in this group at
      typefaceFilePath - The typeface to draw text in on this group's user-interface components
      textPadding - The padding to place around text drawn on this group's user-interface components
      textSize - The size to draw text at on this group's user-interface components in percent of the original typeface's size on the framework's default window size
      Returns:
      Whether all parameters were valid and this group was initialized successfully
